_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. slug = output folder name under docs/research/ad-library/. country = ISO market (IN, US, CA, AE, ALL). status = ACTIVE (running now) | INACTIVE | ALL. maxAds = top-N per brand by revealed-winner. Each brand: name (used in output), bucket (any label you sweep by — D2C/protein, local/education, ...), and OPTIONAL page_id. PIN page_id to avoid the wrong-brand trap; without it the script resolves by name + score and warns you to verify (read pages.md, then pin).
